Rafeeq 2.0 is rebuilt from the ground up: smaller, quicker to open and smoother everywhere, with the same Rafeeq you know.

• Tap any ayah in the 16 Line Quran to listen; the ayah being recited is highlighted and the page turns with it
• Recitation keeps playing with the screen off, with controls on the lock screen
• A new Qibla compass that turns smoothly, with a gentle tick as you turn and a firm one when you face the Qibla
• The ruku sign now sits at the end of its ayah in the 16 Line Quran
• Smooth page turns in the 16 Line Quran\n• A clearer highlight for the ayah being recited in dark mode\n• A solid bottom bar, and swipe between months in the Hijri calendar

• Your location is found faster, even indoors and with approximate location
• Setting up Rafeeq no longer waits for your location
• Paused recitation resumes where it stopped
• All our apps in About, and a much smaller download
• Fixed location sometimes not updating\n• The Hijri correction now moves the calendar\'s dates too\n• Many smaller fixes
IndoPak is the script printed in Pakistan and India; Uthmani is the Madinah mushaf\'s.
